title: Casco at the Pentagon: DISA J-6 Cyber Awareness Forum Recap
summary: Casco opened the DISA J-6 Cyber Awareness Forum at the Pentagon with a talk on continuous security testing and met Brigadier General Francisco J. Dominguez.
body_markdown:
# Casco at the Pentagon: A DISA J-6 Recap


Written by


[Rene Brandel](https://linkedin.com/in/renebrandel)


on


Fri Oct 02 2026


On September 23, 2026, we joined the[DISA J-6 Cyber Awareness Forum](https://disa.fbcevent.com/home) at the Pentagon. I gave an opening talk:[The Death of Point-in-Time Pentesting & Rise of Agentic Red Teaming](https://disa.fbcevent.com/agenda/session/1943108) .


A pentest is a snapshot. Software keeps changing after the test ends. I talked about the gaps that leaves, and how AI agents can keep testing, validate vulnerabilities, and retest fixes while people focus on the work that needs judgment.


We also met[Brigadier General Francisco J. Dominguez](https://disa.fbcevent.com/agenda/speakers/4039640) , Vice Director for Operations of DISA's J-6 C4 Enterprise Directorate.


Ian and I started Casco just last year. Speaking at the Pentagon this soon was wild. Thank you to the DISA J-6 team for having us.


We couldn't take photos inside the Pentagon, so here's Ian and me "practicing" the meeting at our hotel. The lamp had no further questions.


Learn more about[Casco for Government](https://casco.com/gov) and our approach to continuous offensive security.
